messages:
sophie-support: customer reports they can't start the free trial because our checkout forces card-on-file and 3DS always fails (browser shows 'Challenge canceled'). customer email: carlos@example.com. Stripe session returns status `requires_action` then client reports loop of challenge UI and final error `authentication_failed`.
alex-billing: ack. do we have the raw payment_session response? request id or stripe charge id?
ryan-payments: looking now. stripe_session_id `cs_live_1GqJ...Xy` logs show `payment_intent` moved to `requires_action` -> `requires_payment_method` with decline code `authentication_failed`.
jules-devex: any frontend errors? sometimes old Stripe SDK versions cause the redirect loop.
sophie-support: they said they're on iOS 14 Safari and used the in-app browser in our mobile webview. they also tried desktop chrome and got same result.
ryan-payments: reproduction steps I used:
1) POST /v1/checkout/sessions with plan=trial & card_required=true
2) client receives `shopping` with `payment_intent.client_secret`
3) call `stripe.handleCardAction(client_secret)` in browser
4) Stripe UI spins then reports `Challenge canceled` and backend sees `authentication_failed`.

Sentry event id: evt-9a8b7c, trace: trace-0a1b2c. server log snippet:
```
payments_service: attempt=3 session=cs_live_1GqJ... result=requires_payment_method code=authentication_failed err=challenge_cancelled
```

alex-billing: thanks. customer needs the trial today. we should offer manual grant while we triage. support, can you confirm billing policy to grant 14-day trial credit? we can issue via internal tool.
sophie-support: yes please. customer approved manual grant.
ryan-payments: I can grant a one-off trial credit. two options:
- short-term: flip feature flag `payments.skip_card_check_for_user` for carlos@example.com (fast, reversible)
- manual: create internal grant: `POST /internal/grants` with `{ "user_email": "carlos@example.com", "grant_type": "free_trial", "duration_days": 14, "reason": "3DS failure" }`

I recommend manual grant and create a ticket to fix the 3DS flow.

jules-devex: likely culprit: our frontend Stripe SDK is pinned to 1.8.x; Stripe changed challenge flow in 1.10+. I'll try upgrading the SDK in a debug branch and repro on mobile webview.

alex-billing: create Jira and link here please.

deploy-bot: created INF-5123: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-5123 (title: "3DS challenge_cancelled loop for mobile webview - Stripe SDK")

sophie-support: granting now via internal tool. grant id `g_2026_4821`. told customer to log out and start trial again — they should be able to proceed without card-on-file. sending confirmation email.
ryan-payments: added temporary flag for 24h `payments.skip_card_check_for_user:carlos@example.com` expiry 1785558200.

sophie-support: customer confirmed they can start trial on desktop. mobile webview still flaky but workaround accepted. they'll use desktop for onboarding.

jules-devex: I reproduced locally after upgrading Stripe SDK to 1.10.2 and the challenge completed successfully. PR incoming: `fix/stripe-3ds-sdk-upgrade`.

alex-billing: next steps:
- (ryan) expire the skip flag after 24h ✅
- (jules) open prod rollout plan and smoke tests (INF-5123)
- (sophie) add note to support KB about mobile webview 3DS fallback and manual grant path
- (ryan) attach Sentry event and stripe_session_id to the Jira

sophie-support: thanks team :thumbsup: customer is happy with the manual grant.
sentry-bot: attached Sentry evt-9a8b7c to INF-5123.
ryan-payments: patch scheduled, will monitor for related errors and follow up in the ticket.
